Integer i, s
Set s = 0
for(i = 1; i <= 3; i = i + 1)
  s = s + i * i * i
end for
Print s

Integer a[5], i, s
Set a = {4, 7, 2, 9, 6}
Set s = 0
for(i = 1; i < 5; i = i + 2)
  s = s + a[i]
end for
Print s

Integer a
Set a = 6
Print (a | 3) + (a & 3) + (a ^ 3)

Integer n, s
Set n = 234, s = 0
while(n > 0)
  s = s + n MOD 10
  n = n / 10
end while
Print s

Integer i, j, c
Set c = 0
for(i = 1; i <= 4; i = i + 1)
  for(j = 1; j <= 3; j = j + 1)
    c = c + 1
  end for
end for
Print c

Integer a
Set a = 3
a = a << 4
a = a >> 3
Print a

Integer check(Integer n)
  if(n MOD 2 == 0)
    return n / 2
  else
    return 3 * n + 1
  end if
End function
Print check(6)

Integer a, b
Set a = 10
b = --a - a--
Print b

Integer fib(Integer n)
  if(n <= 1)
    return n
  end if
  return fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)
End function
Print fib(6)

Integer a, b
Set a = 4, b = 9
if((a < 5 || b > 10) && (a + b == 13))
  Print 1
else
  Print 0
end if

Integer d
Set d = 5
switch(d)
  case 3: Print 30
  case 5: Print 50
  case 7: Print 70
  default: Print 0
end switch

Integer a
Set a = 100
a = a MOD 30
a = a MOD 4
Print a

Integer i, c
Set i = 10, c = 0
while(i > 0)
  c = c + 1
  i = i - 1
end while
Print c
